Tiny Swords (Free Pack)
=======================

Author : Pixel Frog
Source : https://pixelfrog-assets.itch.io/tiny-swords
Version: Free Pack, imported 2026-10-16 (folder renamed from "Tiny Swords (Free Pack)")

Terms (as recorded in the project's tooling decision, ADR-000):
- Free for personal and commercial use; credit is appreciated but not required.
- Redistribution or resale of the assets themselves, modified or not, is not allowed.

Because of the redistribution clause this repository must not be published publicly with
this folder included; access is shared privately with the reviewers.

Contents are used unmodified. Only Unity import settings and sprite atlases (under
Assets/_Project/Art/Atlases) are project-specific.
